latest_release.name: v3.3.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: Tell dependabot to update GH Actions by @olleolleolle in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1963
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 4 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1966
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1965
* build(deps): bump codecov/codecov-action from 5 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1964
* build(deps-dev): bump flatted from 3.3.3 to 3.4.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1945
* build(deps-dev): bump c8 from 10.1.3 to 11.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1931
* build(deps-dev): bump supertest from 7.1.4 to 7.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1924
* build(deps): bump type-is from 2.0.1 to 2.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1969
* build(deps): bump minimatch from 3.1.2 to 3.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1962
* fix: response content-type value amount as one with testcase by @PoChenKuo in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1899
* docs: fix app.currentContext example (read the getter, don't assign to it) by @DucMinhNe in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1978
* build(deps): bump codecov/codecov-action from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1979
* docs: improve JSDoc parameter descriptions for `Application` constructor by @kshitijanurag in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1941
* feat: re-export http-errors utilities by @nuintun in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1991
* ci: bump node versions to 22-26 by @jonathanong in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1972
* patch: make ctx.assert errors instanceof HttpError by @yowainwright in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1998
* fix: parse absolute-form request targets in request.URL by @xia-chao in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1999
* docs: point request.hostname URL link at current Node.js docs by @JiuYue0820 in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1994
* fix(response): keep the Blob content type instead of forcing octet-stream by @spokodev in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1987
* fix: reject multiple values for singleton response headers by @shuaiyafei in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2012
* fix: preserve booleans when assigning query parameters by @tianrking in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2013
* fix: prevent prototype mutation when parsing query parameters by @yowainwright in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2024
* fix: keep prototype-based HttpError instanceof checks by @jonathanong in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2025
* chore: minor release bump by @yowainwright in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2031
* fix: preserve HttpError subclass instance checks by @yowainwright in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2033
* fix: lowercase X-Forwarded-Proto in request.protocol by @jipeng6036-del in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2029
* fix: parse IPv6 hostname from request.host by @yowainwright in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2034

## New Contributors
* @PoChenKuo made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1899
* @DucMinhNe made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1978
* @kshitijanurag made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1941
* @nuintun made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1991
* @xia-chao made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1999
* @JiuYue0820 made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1994
* @spokodev made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/1987
* @shuaiyafei made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2012
* @tianrking made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2013
* @jipeng6036-del made their first contribution in https://github.com/koajs/koa/pull/2029

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/koa
